description: The companies and people in an article or a story, ready to add to CRM by Hottub. Each has add_url (CRM by Hottub's add form, filled in; the person presses Add) and propose (arguments for CRM by Hottub's propose_relationship tool, which an owner approves). Give item (n_… or s_…) or story (st_…); or q to gather the organizations and people named across recent news on a subject, most often named first.

item.description: An item id from search_news or get_story

kind.description: With q: only organizations, or only people

q.description: A subject, in any language, e.g. "battery factory expansion"

since.description: With q: RFC 3339, a date, or an age like "3d" (default 7d)

name: find_prospects
title: Find prospects for CRM by Hottub
